text:
Nora: dropped a prototype for a tiny p95 thumbnail strip that sits above charts. intent: give quick glanceable hotspots + a compact time scrubber. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/thumbs/p95-thumbstrip (screenshot) Hank: looks useful. two quick things: tiny thumbnails can lose bucket shape. suggest an optional "snap-to-bucket" overlay when zooming in so users see exact boundaries. :mag: Lina: ux call: how about a long-press gesture on mobile to flip into full scrubber mode? avoids cluttering desktop controls. long-press opens an expanded timeline with handles. :iphone: Jess: a11y nits: 1) thumbnail needs role="region" and an accessible name like "Latency thumbnail"; 2) scrubber handle must have aria-label and ARIA keyboard support (Home/End, arrows). also focus outline should be visible at 3px and not rely on color alone. Omar: perf note: render thumbnails at lower resolution and cache tiles. also precompute a "p95-spark" sprite so we can reuse image tiles instead of re-rendering every time. Nora: copy idea for mini-tooltip: current: "p95 300ms @ 15:02" proposed: "p95: 300ms 15:02" (colon vs dash). short and consistent. Also thinking of micro-copy for the thumbnail toggle: "Expand timeline" vs "Open scrubber" 1 which reads better? Hank: prefer "Open scrubber" 1 more action-focused. Also propose a tiny hint under hover: "Press Enter to preview range, press P to pin" - quick keyboard hints are useful for power users. Lina: mobile gesture nuance: long-press for full scrubber, but also allow two-finger pinch to zoom timeline. ensure we provide an alternative in settings for users who can't do pinch gestures. Jess: keyboard announcement snippet I used elsewhere: ```
Previewing 2m range: p95 300ms
``` Make sure the SR text includes units and the phrase "p95" early so screen reader users get context. Omar: implementation note: when previewing without pinning, don't update global timepicker state. emit event `thumbnail:preview({start,end})` and `thumbnail:pin({start,end})` for pinned changes. also include `sampling:mode` in the event payload so the main chart can adjust rendering. Nora: decisions: 1) change micro-copy to "Open scrubber", 2) add snap-to-bucket overlay toggle on zoom, 3) implement long-press to expand on mobile + pinch opt-in in accessibility settings, 4) aria attrs and SR live region as Jess suggested, 5) events as Omar proposed. I'll update the figma with these changes and push by EOD. tagging @Hank @Jess for follow-up. :rocket: Hank: I'll prototype the snap overlay and share perf numbers. thanks!
